Forward a message (saves a draft unless you add --send)

Related commands:
  reply
  draft update
  send
  read

Output:
  Shows text you can read in your terminal.
  Use --json to get JSON for scripts and other programs.
  Use --jq to filter the JSON output with a jq expression.
  Use --template to format the output with a Go template.

Usage:
  maildo forward [id] [flags]

Examples:
maildo forward 9eac029 --to anna@example.com --body "FYI"
maildo forward --id 3c1f2a7 --account work --to client@example.com --body-file note.md --markdown
maildo forward --query "from:client@example.com subject:quote" --latest --to client@example.com --body "FYI" --send --dry-run
maildo forward 9eac029 --to anna@example.com --body "FYI" --include-attachments none
maildo forward --id 3c1f2a7 --body "Preview" --dry-run --json

Flags:
      --account stringArray                 Account to use (default: the active account)
      --approve string                      Approval code from the --dry-run preview; maildo sends only if the message still matches it, and only once
      --bcc stringArray                     Bcc recipient; repeat the flag or separate addresses with commas
      --body string                         Message body as text
      --body-file string                    Read the message body from a file, or from stdin with -
      --cc stringArray                      Cc recipient; repeat the flag or separate addresses with commas
      --draft                               Save the forward as a draft (the default)
      --first                               With --query, the same as --latest
      --full                                Show the whole body in the preview, also when it is long
  -h, --help                                help for forward
      --html                                Write the body in HTML; maildo removes unsafe parts
      --id string                           Message id, or a short id from list or search
      --include-attachment stringArray      Name of an attachment of the original to send along (repeatable)
      --include-attachment-id stringArray   Id of an attachment of the original to send along (repeatable)
      --include-attachments string          Which attachments of the original go along: all or none (default "all")
      --internet-id string                  Message-ID header of the message, such as <id@example.com>
      --latest                              With --query, use the newest match
      --markdown                            Write the body in Markdown; maildo turns it into HTML
      --query string                        Search for the message; use with --latest or --first
      --send                                Send the forward instead of saving a draft
      --text                                Write the body as plain text
      --to stringArray                      To recipient; repeat the flag or separate addresses with commas
      --yes                                 Send without asking; needs --approve unless the account allows unattended sends

Global Flags:
      --config string     Path to the config file
      --dry-run           Preview changes without performing them
      --include-meta      Wrap the JSON output as {data, meta} with request details
      --jq string         Filter the JSON output with a jq expression
      --json              Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi           Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color          Disable color in human output
      --no-pager          Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt         Never block on an interactive prompt
      --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
      --template string   Format the JSON output with a Go text/template
